channel.title: Nation of Change - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Nation of Change (nationofchange.org)

item.title: California votes to protect mountain lions under the state Endangered Species Act
item.description: The vote secured the Southern California and Central Coast mountain lions as a distinct population segment (DPS) and listed both populations as threatened under CESA because of their vulnerability to these threats and becoming locally extinct.

item.title: Trump EPA abandons climate working group report in endangerment finding repeal
item.description: Emails from the hand-picked, secretive group of climate crisis deniers revealed flaws in their methods and “animus” toward leading scientists.

item.title: Trump tries to turn Greenland into Okinawa
item.description: It’s part of the new, heightened indifference to sovereignty of the Trump administration.

item.title: Seattle protesters confront Amazon over ICE contracts and surveillance ties
item.description: Workers, activists, and city officials rally outside the Spheres as Amazon drops Flock partnership but faces mounting pressure to end cloud support for ICE and CBP.
